what_this_is: Digests written to Cardano preprod so that 'this existed by time T' is a fact about a block rather than a claim in a document.
why: An AWS Nitro attestation's certificates expire in about three hours. After that, the only evidence of when the document was produced is a timestamp its own author wrote, and nothing cryptographic prevents backdating. A block does what the signature cannot.
what_an_anchor_proves: That these 32 bytes existed no later than the block carrying the transaction. Nothing about what they mean, who wrote them, or whether they are true.

anchors.note: The subject is the vendored 2022 sample in packages/attestation/fixtures, whose certificates expired long ago. Anchoring it demonstrates the mechanism; it does not make a 2022 document newer.

anchors.subject: the verdict: manifest hash, evidence root and final verdict
anchors.note: Anchors the VERDICT rather than the whole bundle: a bundle gains fields after settlement, so anchoring it whole would produce a digest nothing could reproduce later.
